_doc: A five-gallon can of kerosene, full (#1172, G2): square tinplate with a screw cap and a wire handle, the way lamp oil came by rail from the 1870s. A loose rigid prop (LooseProp, as the tin cup): knocked off, it rolls; a ball holes it through both sides; a fall or a kick dents it. Modelled and baked in tools/blender/props/store_g2.py. Written by tools/props/store_g2.py.
